objections.objection: The burden is on the trans person to justify departing from their natal sex. Absent a successful justification — metaphysical (that one can change sex) or therapeutic (that intervention is medically necessary) — there is no right to transition; the default is to remain as assigned.

rebuttal.short: The objection loses on the burden before any evidence is heard. A sex-role assigned at birth was assigned without the assignee's assent — and an ascription no one consented to cannot be the thing a dissenter is obliged to rebut. So the demand to justify departing from your natal sex inverts: the standing question is not what licenses departure but what licenses holding a person to an unchosen assignment over their own name, body, and bearing. Nothing does, by default. The authority runs to the chooser; the one asserting power over another's self-presentation carries the burden of justifying that conscription. And this needs no claim that sex really changed: the right is a permission to withhold assent to an assignment, not a thesis about gender's metaphysics — so however that dispute resolves, it never reaches the right.
rebuttal.medium:
The objection loses on the burden before any evidence is weighed. It frames departure from one's natal sex as the thing requiring a warrant — metaphysical or therapeutic — and treats remaining-as-assigned as the costless default. But the assignment was made at birth, without the assignee's assent, and an ascription no one consented to has no default authority to bind the person it was placed on. We grant this everywhere else: a person owes no justification for departing from the religion, name, nationality, or vocation ascribed to them at birth before they are conceded authority over their own life. Sex/gender presentation is not the exception; treating it as one is the move that has to be argued, and the objection simply assumes it.

So the burden inverts. The standing question is not "what licenses departure?" but "what licenses holding a person to an unchosen assignment over their own name, body, and bearing?" — and the party asserting that power carries it, not the dissenter.

Crucially, this concedes the objector's strongest premise and still wins. Grant arguendo that sex is biologically fixed and immutable. The right is untouched, because it never rested on sex being changeable — it rests on the chooser, not the assignment, holding authority over how they present and embody themselves. The metaphysical dispute is real and may go the objector's way; it lands on a claim the right does not make. Nor does the right need the therapeutic warrant: it does not say transition relieves suffering and is therefore owed — that would smuggle in a value-ranking the suite refuses. It says only that an unchosen assignment binds no one against their assent.
rebuttal.long:
The objection is a burden-allocation move wearing the costume of an evidentiary demand, and it loses at the allocation step, before any evidence is heard.

Its structure: departure from one's natal sex is the thing that needs a warrant — either metaphysical (a demonstration that sex can be changed) or therapeutic (a demonstration that intervention is medically necessary) — while remaining-as-assigned is the costless, pre-justified default. Two burdens are bundled here and should be pulled apart. One is the burden of establishing a positive claim about the world (that sex is mutable) or about a treatment (that it is indicated). The other is the burden of exercising a self-regarding permission — of being the one who decides how one is named, embodied, and presented. The objection's whole force comes from charging the second to the account of the first: it makes the permission hostage to a metaphysical or clinical proof.

But the sex-role at issue was assigned at birth, without the assignee's assent. An ascription that no one consented to cannot be the default authority that a dissenter must overcome — it is not authority at all until something makes it so, and "it was assigned" makes nothing so. We treat this as obvious in every neighboring case. A person raised in a faith, given a name, sorted into a nationality or a trade at birth, owes no one a justification for leaving it before being conceded authority over their own life; the authority is theirs by default, and anyone who would hold them to the natal ascription is the one who must justify the holding. Sex/gender presentation is asserted to be the lone exception to this. That assertion is exactly what the objection needs and exactly what it never argues — it assumes the exception and calls the assumption a burden of proof.

Allocate the burden honestly and it inverts. The standing question is not "what licenses departure from the assignment?" but "what licenses holding a person to an unchosen assignment, over their own name, body, and bearing, against their assent?" That is a claim of authority over another person, and the party making it carries the burden — not the dissenter, who is merely declining to be bound by something they never agreed to.

This is why the node concedes the objector's strongest card and still takes the hand. Grant, arguendo and in full, that sex is biological, fixed, and immutable — that no intervention really changes it. The right is untouched. It never rested on sex being changeable; it rests on the chooser, not the assignment, holding authority over self-presentation. The metaphysical dispute is genuine and may resolve against the trans claimant on its own terms; it resolves about a thesis the right does not assert. Symmetrically, the right declines the therapeutic warrant on purpose. It does not argue that transition relieves dysphoria and is therefore owed or advisable — that would convert a permission into a value-ranking of how a life should go, which this library refuses across the board. It argues only the narrow thing: an assignment made without assent binds no one against it.

One gesture remains. Society has an interest in stable categories — in shared sex-terms, in sorted spaces, in legible records. Granted; but this is a claim about effects on third parties, and it is adjudicated where third-party claims are adjudicated — through the harm principle's preconditions: is the cost direct or routed through others' choices, is foreclosing the right the narrowest effective instrument or does a channel-specific policy reach the cost, does foreclosure backfire on the very metric invoked. It does not retroactively convert a self-regarding permission into something requiring pre-justification. The interest, however real, is not a license to conscript a person's self-presentation as the instrument that secures it.

What is left when the burden is set straight is the spine the rest of the library inherits: no one is conscripted into living under a sex/gender assignment made without their assent, and the standing refusal of that conscription simply is the authority to self-determine. That is the autonomy frame, and it is deliberately not the value frame. The case never says transition is good, healthy, or to be encouraged. It says the assignment has no claim on the assignee that the assignee did not grant — which is the most the suite will ever say, and, against an objection that the burden falls the other way, exactly enough.

register_compliance.firewall_clean: Suffering/dysphoria-relief is explicitly DECLINED as a warrant (the therapeutic-decline passages), not invoked. The node grounds only a non-domination permission; it makes no suffering-reduction claim, defensive or affirmative.

objections.objection: No coherent referent grounds the gender you claim to self-determine. Sex is a biological fact, binary and immutable; an inner gender-as-essence is incoherent and unfalsifiable, tracking no fact of the matter. So self-determination has no object — nothing real is determined — and you assert a falsehood others are then asked to encode in speech and record.

rebuttal.short: Concede the whole primitive, arguendo: sex is a biological fact, and ‘inner gender as essence’ names nothing coherent or falsifiable. The right is still untouched, because its objects were never an inner essence — they are concrete and uncontested as real: one’s own name, dress, body, role, and how one asks to be referred to. Authority over these is the person’s by the spine’s non-domination ground; it does not wait on a metaphysics of gender to exist, and the incoherence-attack strikes a referent the right does not use. Nor does self-presenting assert a falsehood: adopting a name and a presentation states no proposition about one’s sex — that reading is the objector’s, not the act’s. So the primitive stands, undefeated, and the right wins anyway: it binds no dissenter to any metaphysics because it asserts none. What others must do with their own speech and records is a separate, bystander question.
rebuttal.medium:
Concede the primitive in full, arguendo: sex is a biological fact, immutable, and ‘inner gender as essence’ names nothing coherent or falsifiable. Grant all of it — and notice the right is untouched, because its objects were never an inner essence. They are concrete and individually uncontested as real: one’s own name, dress, body, social role, and the terms one asks to be used of oneself. Authority over these is the person’s by the spine’s non-domination ground, and it does not wait on a metaphysics of gender to exist. The incoherence-attack strikes a referent the right does not occupy.

The objection’s hardest card is that self-presenting asserts a falsehood — ‘I am a woman’ — and demands others affirm it. But adopting a name and a presentation asserts no proposition about one’s sex; that reading is supplied by the objector, not entailed by the act, and the autonomy frame declines to make it. No falsehood is asserted, so there is nothing to convict. The real residue — what one may require of other people, in their speech or records — is not metaphysical at all; it is a bystander question, adjudicated through the harm principle, and it belongs to another node.

So the primitive stands, undefeated, and the right wins anyway. The dissenter keeps full permission to withhold metaphysical assent; what they lack is standing to override another’s authority over their own name, body, and bearing — and that was always grounded in non-domination, not in the metaphysics. The case never asserts anyone really is a woman or a man, or that transition is good. It says only that a permission over one’s own self-presentation binds no dissenter to a metaphysics, because it asserts none.
rebuttal.long:
This objection, unlike the burden-allocation move, begs no question — it presses a real metaphysical claim, and the right answer is not to contest the metaphysics but to show the right never needed it. So concede the primitive in full, arguendo: sex is a biological fact, binary and immutable; and ‘inner gender as essence’ names nothing coherent — no determinate, falsifiable property a self could be said to track. Grant all of it. Asserting the rival — that trans women really are women, that gender-as-essence is sound — would be a different and worse move: it hands the objector the whole battlefield, since the right now stands or falls with a contested metaphysics, and it re-imports exactly the value-laden truth-claim the suite is built to do without. The node asserts no metaphysics. That is its strength, not an evasion.

What, then, does the right range over? Not an inner essence. Its objects are concrete and, individually, uncontested as real: one’s own name; one’s dress, grooming, and bearing; one’s own body and what is done to it; the social role one occupies; and the terms one asks to be used in referring to oneself. Each is a thing a competent adult holds authority over by the same non-domination ground the spine established — no second party has default standing to override how a person is named, embodied, and presented, absent a harm to others. The incoherence of gender-as-essence is therefore a clean strike on a target the right does not occupy. Authority over how you are named and embodied does not wait on a metaphysics of gender to become real; it is real already, on objects that exist whether or not ‘inner gender’ refers to anything. The objector has refuted a thesis about essences and left the permission over concretes exactly where it was.

The objection’s sharpest remaining edge is the charge of dishonesty: that adopting a woman’s name and presentation asserts the proposition ‘I am a woman,’ a falsehood by the conceded metaphysics, and demands others affirm it. But self-presenting asserts no proposition about one’s sex or one’s essence. A name is a name; dress is dress; a request is a request. The metaphysical proposition — ‘X is, in the contested essence-sense, a woman’ — is supplied by the objector as a reading of the act; it is not entailed by the act, and the autonomy frame declines to make it. There is, then, no falsehood being asserted, and nothing to convict: one cannot be lying by presenting, when presenting states nothing about the fact the objector holds fixed.

One genuine residue survives, and it is not metaphysical. When self-presentation requires other people to do something — to use particular terms, to alter records, to sort shared spaces — the question stops being ‘is there an object for your self-determination?’ and becomes ‘what may you require of third parties?’ That is an other-regarding, bystander question, adjudicated where those are: through the harm principle’s preconditions — is the cost direct or routed through others’ choices, is the proposed instrument the narrowest effective one, does it backfire on its own metric — not through a metaphysics of gender. The metaphysical objection cannot reach it; the bystander objection, when run, is run on its own ground. Using ‘you’d make me say a falsehood’ to defeat the self-regarding permission is the objection borrowing force from a fight that belongs to another node.

What is left is a primitive that stands, undefeated, and a right that wins anyway. The objector may go on holding that sex is fixed and inner gender incoherent; nothing in a trans adult’s authority over their own name, body, and bearing requires that objector to revise a single belief. The dissenter keeps full permission to withhold metaphysical assent. What the dissenter lacks is standing to override the person’s authority over concrete self-presentation — and that lack was never grounded in the metaphysics; it was grounded, by the spine, in non-domination. So the metaphysical objection, granted in full, leaves the right precisely where it found it. The case still never says that anyone is really a woman or a man, that transition is good, or that it should be encouraged. It says only that a permission over one’s own name, body, and presentation binds no dissenter to a metaphysics, because it asserts none — which is the most the suite will ever say, and, against an objection that the right has no object, exactly enough.

register_compliance.firewall_clean: No suffering/dysphoria claim, defensive or affirmative. The node grants the objector’s metaphysical primitive arguendo and grounds only a non-domination permission over concrete self-presentation; it asserts no rival metaphysics (Williams-trap avoided) and makes no value-ranking of transition.

objections.tier_justification: Conceptual-Residue Arguendo: grant the objector’s primitive in full — sex-as-biological-fact AND the incoherence/non-referent of inner-gender-as-essence. The rebuttal does NOT defeat it (asserting a rival metaphysics — ‘gender-essence is coherent’ / ‘trans women are women’ — is the Williams-trap, ruled out by charter L142/L179 and the firewall); it DISSOLVES-BUT-LEAVES-STANDING: the primitive stays intelligible and undefeated, and the right wins on the permission axis (binds-no-dissenter, asserting no metaphysics) after relocating its object to concrete self-presentation. A standing, conceded primitive caps the ceiling ⇒ T4 (genuine-philosophical), expected B (charter T4-primitive-conceder signature; long 0.8733/B confirms). G1 PASS / distinct from the spine: the spine’s arguendo-concession was instrumental to defeating the T3 burden-allocation move and is explicitly delegated to S1 by the spine’s own tier_justification; S1 works the category-incoherence/assert-a-falsehood premise the spine left standing, inheriting the non-domination ground and applying it to a new objector premise. The institutional-encoding / compel-others residue routes to bystander (B1/S4), gated.

objections.objection: Your body was given to you — by God, by nature, by your parents — as a gift. To alter it is ingratitude and defacement: you owe the giver the body's preservation, un-altered. Gender-affirming alteration breaks that debt of gratitude and disrespects the source of the gift, so you have no right to it.

rebuttal.short: The objection's force is in one inference: the body is a gift, so you owe the giver its preservation un-altered, and to alter it is ingratitude. Grant that the body is a gift — the inference still fails, on the objector's own consistency. A duty that genuinely followed from giftedness would bind against every alteration: haircuts, fillings, vaccines, the surgery that saves a life. None is charged with ingratitude. A duty invoked against transition alone and dormant for the rest is not a duty owed to the giver; it is a prohibition on one disfavored choice in gift's clothing. And applied consistently — all alteration a slight, transition a grave one — it remains a first-person attitude about one's own given-body, grounding no authority over another's self-regarding choice. Withholding assent binds no dissenter. The case never says transition is good; only that no provenance turns an unchosen body into a debt discharged by leaving it as it came.
rebuttal.medium:
The objection bundles a value with an inference, and only the inference does work. Grant the value: the body is a gift — from God, nature, or one's parents. The inference — that a gift imposes a duty to preserve it un-altered, so altering is ingratitude — breaks on the objector's own consistency.

A preservation-duty that genuinely followed from giftedness would bind against every alteration of the given body. It does not. No one who presses it against transition presses it against haircuts, fillings, vaccines, or the surgery that saves a life — each alters the given body, none is charged with ingratitude. A duty asserted against one disfavored alteration and dormant for a thousand others is not a duty owed to the giver; it is a prohibition on a particular choice wearing gift-language. So the inference fails: gift forbids all alteration — a reductio that would indict the dentist — or none in particular, and the trans case is one in particular.

The retreat — alteration that rejects the given kind — re-imports a normatively loaded kind an alteration can betray. That is the metaphysics objection, answered in its own node: grant the kind is fixed, the authority over one's self-regarding body still does not turn on it. Drop the duty, or collapse into that case.

And if the objector bites the bullet — all alteration a pro tanto slight, transition gravely so? Concede it entire. It is a first-person attitude about what one owes one's own given-body, and grounds no authority over a second person's choice. Withholding assent binds no dissenter. The case never says transition is good — only that no provenance turns an unchosen body into a debt its bearer must discharge by leaving it untouched.
rebuttal.long:
The objection bundles a value with an inference, and only the inference is load-bearing. The value: the body is a gift — from God, from nature, from one's parents. The inference: a gift imposes a duty to preserve it, so to alter the body is to wrong the giver, and the trans person, by altering, defaults on a debt of gratitude. Grant the value in full. The inference is where it breaks, and it breaks on the objector's own consistency.

A duty to preserve the given body un-altered, if it genuinely followed from the body's being a gift, would bind against every alteration of that body. It does not. No one who presses giftedness against transition presses it against the haircut, the filled cavity, the vaccine, the vasectomy, or the surgeon's knife that saves a life. Each alters the given body; each is met with no charge of ingratitude. The preservation-duty is asserted against one alteration and sleeps through a thousand others — and a duty that wakes only against a disfavored instance is not a duty owed to the giver, but a prohibition on a particular choice, with the language of gift recruited afterward to lend it the weight of obligation. So the inference fails: either gift forbids all alteration — a reductio that would indict the dentist alongside the transition — or it forbids none in particular, and the trans case is one alteration in particular.

The objector has one retreat: not all alteration, but alteration that rejects the given sex or kind — the haircut honors the body, transition repudiates what it was given as. This smuggles back a normatively loaded kind an alteration can betray: a claim about what the body is for, not about gratitude for a gift. That is the metaphysics objection, and it routes to the node that takes the metaphysics head-on — grant arguendo that sex is fixed and that there is a kind the body belongs to, and the authority to alter one's own self-regarding body still does not turn on it, because the right was never a thesis about the body's metaphysics. So the objector faces a fork with no exit: drop the preservation-duty, or watch it collapse into a claim answered elsewhere.

Suppose instead the objector bites the bullet — accepts the consistency charge and holds that all elective alteration is pro tanto a slight to the giver, transition merely a grave one: a general, scalar duty, consistently applied. Concede even this, entire. The body is unchosen; perhaps one does owe one's given-body a gratitude that counsels leaving it as it came. Grant the whole picture true — and it still does not reach. It is a first-person attitude, a stance about what I owe my given-body, and a first-person attitude grounds no authority over a second person's self-regarding choice. I may hold that I should not alter mine, and decline to; that confers no standing to forbid you altering yours. Withholding assent binds no dissenter. At its strongest the gift-duty is a reason I may act on for myself — never a lever with which to move you.

One gesture, leaned on lightly and named as such. The gratitude-from-gift picture assumes a transfer one could have declined and accepted. A body you were born into you could neither refuse nor return; an imposition you cannot decline is not the kind of transfer that places the recipient in the giver's debt — and if any debt runs in an unchosen imposition, it runs from the one who imposed to the one left to live with it. This leans on a contestable account of when unsolicited transfers generate obligation, and the case does not need it: the consistency-defeat and the permission-cap carry without it. It amplifies; it does not bear weight.

And the giver said to be wronged — parent, community, God? Insofar as that is a claim about a third party harmed by a self-regarding act, it has stopped being the gift-objection and become a harm-to-others claim, adjudicated where those are, through the harm principle's preconditions, in another node. It does not convert a self-regarding choice back into a debt.

What is left is the wing's spine, untouched. The case never says transition is good, or that anyone should alter the body they were given. It says only that no provenance — divine, natural, or parental — turns an unchosen body into a debt its bearer must discharge by leaving it as it arrived. That is the most the suite will ever say, and against an objection that the body's origin binds the one who lives in it, exactly enough.

register_compliance.firewall_clean: Argues only sovereignty/consent: a selectively-applied preservation-duty is no gift-duty (Route A), and even granted entire it binds no dissenter (Route B). No suffering/dysphoria claim, defensive or affirmative. Debt-inversion is a NAMED-DEPENDENCE amplifier — it leans on a contestable account of obligation-from-unsolicited-gifts and carries no weight the core needs; the consistency-defeat + permission-cap carry alone (the asymmetry-independence analogue). No Benatar asymmetry.

objections.tier_justification: Conceptual-Residue Arguendo, two-route. LOAD-BEARING (Route A): grant the gift-premise arguendo (the body is a gift); the rebuttal DEFEATS the gift->preservation-duty inference, it does not merely dissolve it — the asserted duty is gerrymandered (a preservation-duty applied to no other alteration the recipient performs: haircuts, dentistry, vaccination, vasectomy, life-saving surgery — is not a gift-duty but a targeted prohibition wearing gift-language; the inference collapses on the objector's own consistency, forcing forbid-all-alteration [reductio] or forbid-none-in-particular). A defeated structural/pragmatic dodge => T3, REVISING the pencilled T4. Per charter L179 a clean T3 defeat may reach boundary-A; the all-B signature governs T4-primitive-conceders only, which this node's spine is not. SECONDARY FLOOR (Route B, named, not co-equal): concede the provenance primitive in full — the body is unchosen, the gift-attitude may be true; it is a first-person attitude about one's OWN given-body and grounds no authority to bind another's self-regarding choice (withholding assent binds no dissenter). That branch dissolves-but-leaves-standing (T4-flavoured) and is the floor at which the bitten-bullet objector — who accepts the consistency charge and holds a general scalar anti-alteration duty — is capped. AMPLIFIER (named-dependence, NOT load-bearing): debt-inversion — an unchosen, unrefusable imposition generates no recipient-duty, and any debt runs imposer->assignee; leans on a contestable obligation-from-unsolicited-gifts account (the asymmetry-independence analogue), core carries without it. G1 PASS: distinct from the spine (a positive provenance-grounded conditioning duty the spine's burden-inversion machinery never addresses) and from S1 (gift _|_ metaphysics — the duty presses whatever sex's metaphysical status). DISTINCTNESS EDGE not subsumption: the retreat-horn — objector narrows the duty to alteration that REJECTS the given sex/kind — re-imports the metaphysics and routes to S1 (foundation); S2 forces drop-the-duty OR collapse-to-S1, both wins, the second is S1's. WILLIAMS-CLEAN: Route A is internal/tu-quoque (no rival ranking of giftedness — the inference fails on the objector's own lights); Route B is a scope/jurisdiction point (giftedness granted true, limited to first-person). Compel-others / harm-to-the-giver / institutional-encoding residue GATED OUT to bystander (B1) / compelled-participation (S4).

objections.objection: Once identity is severed from any external truth-maker and grounded in bare self-declaration, no non-arbitrary principle distinguishes the gender self-ID you protect from species, age, or race self-ID, which you do not. Either protect all of them — absurd, and corrosive of the categories and resources others rely on — or your protection of gender self-ID is arbitrary special-pleading. Any line you draw either re-imports the metaphysics you conceded or is bare stipulation. So self-ID grounds no right.

rebuttal.short: The objection assumes the only non-arbitrary stopping rule must rest on a metaphysical truth about which identity is real, so that severing gender self-ID from a truth-maker leaves bare self-declaration with no brake — licensing a self-declared species or age, or exposed as arbitrary. But the stopping rule was never metaphysical: it is the line liberalism draws across all liberty, between self-regarding and other-regarding acts, and exhibiting it refutes the claim that none exists. A privately lived race or age self-conception that asks nothing of others is no one's business, and the right protects it — the slope ends somewhere unalarming; the cases that alarm are blocked on their other-regarding reach, not on any denial of self-ID, and gender claims are checked at that same joint when they cross it, which is why sorted spaces and compelled speech route elsewhere. The line treats gender and species alike and ranks neither, so special-pleading fails; and granted contestable at the margin, the slope-form proves too much — turned on conversion, divorce, or renaming it voids every liberty of self-authorship and singles out nothing. The case never says anyone really is the kind they present, or that transition is good — only that the gender claim sits on the self-regarding side with every other self-authored liberty, which is exactly the limit the objection says cannot exist.
rebuttal.medium:
The objection assumes the only non-arbitrary stopping rule must rest on a metaphysical truth about which identity is real — so that severing gender self-ID from any truth-maker leaves bare self-declaration with no internal brake, licensing a self-declared species or age on the same logic, or standing exposed as arbitrary. The premise is wrong, and the right never rested on it. The stopping rule here was never metaphysical: it is the line liberalism draws across all liberty, between self-regarding and other-regarding acts.

The harm principle marks that jurisdictional boundary, and exhibiting it refutes the claim that no such principle exists. Run the cases: a privately lived race or age self-conception that asks nothing of anyone is genuinely no one's business, and the right protects it — the slope ends somewhere unalarming. The cases that do alarm are blocked on their other-regarding reach — enrolment as a minor, a reserved remedy, exemption from a general law — never on a denial of the self-ID itself. Gender claims are checked at that same joint the moment they cross into other-regarding territory, which is why sorted spaces and compelled speech route to a different node entirely. The line treats gender and species identically and ranks neither, so the special-pleading charge fails.

A demand for a metaphysical truth-maker for the line is only the metaphysics objection returning in other clothes — what makes something self-regarding is whose life it sits in, not the essence of gender — and it collapses back into the node that already answers it. And granting the boundary contestable at the margin, the slope-form still proves too much: turned on religious conversion, divorce, renaming, or renunciation — each equally self-authored and uncertified — it would void every liberty of self-authorship and single out nothing.

A form that defeats every liberty of self-authorship defeats itself on the objector's own terms; the deliberately absurd cases name nothing anyone lives as and never enter the analysis, and the separate worry that self-ID corrodes shared categories is a third-party-harm claim routed elsewhere, not a slope. What remains is a principled, symmetrical distinction between what is yours to live and what reaches into another's life — not the metaphysics the objection demands, but a real and grounded line. The case never says anyone is really the kind they present, or that transition is good; only that the gender claim sits on the self-regarding side with every other liberty of self-authorship — which is exactly the limit the objection says cannot exist.
rebuttal.long:
The objection hinges on a hidden premise: that metaphysical reality is the only non-arbitrary stopping rule. Sever gender from any external truth-maker, the thought runs, and self-declaration becomes bare stipulation with no internal brake — which would license a self-declared species, age, or race on identical logic. So either protect them all, or admit the gender line is arbitrary. The premise is false, and the right never needed what it demands.

The actual stopping rule is not metaphysical at all. It is the boundary liberalism draws across every liberty: the line between self-regarding and other-regarding conduct, the same harm-principle jurisdiction this wing already uses to adjudicate third-party costs. The objects of the right are self-regarding concretes — one's own name, dress, body, bearing, and the terms one asks to be used of oneself. That line is not retrofitted onto gender to save it; it is the general distinction already sorting speech, religion, vocation, and bodily autonomy. Exhibiting one non-arbitrary principle is enough to refute a claim that none exists.

Run the objector's own test cases through that boundary rather than the invented metaphysical one, and the slope flattens where it was supposed to alarm. Someone who privately understands themselves as younger, as another race, as otherkin — who dresses and refers to themselves accordingly while asking nothing of anyone — is doing something genuinely no one else's business, and the right protects it cleanly. The slope, run honestly, terminates somewhere unalarming. The confidence that we obviously protect none of this borrows all its force from quietly picturing the other-regarding version instead.

The cases that do alarm — demanding enrolment as a minor, claiming a remedy reserved for a historically racialized group, exemption from a law that binds everyone — are blocked, but not because the self-identification is denied. The block lands on the other-regarding reach: the displacement of a third party, the claim on someone else's resource. The harm principle gates that reach whatever identity stands behind it. This is exactly where the special-pleading charge collapses, because the gender claim meets the same boundary at the same joint the moment it turns other-regarding — which is what is really at stake in sex-segregated sport, sorted spaces, and compelled speech. Those are not settled by a metaphysics of who is really what; they are routed to where third-party costs are weighed. The line ranks gender and every rival identity-claim identically: protected as self-regarding, checked as other-regarding. That symmetry is what makes it principled rather than a line drawn to flatter one case.

One retreat remains: that without a metaphysical ground, even this boundary floats — some fact must explain why gender self-presentation counts as self-regarding at all, and absent it the framework is arbitrary after all. But that is the metaphysical demand again, wearing jurisdictional dress, and it is answered the way the original was. What makes one's name, dress, and body self-regarding is not a fact about gender's essence; it is that they are the concrete particulars of a single person's own life, over which non-domination already grants authority. Self-presentation needs a metaphysics of gender no more than the right itself did. So the objector faces the same fork the foundation node forces: drop the demand for a truth-maker, or watch the slope collapse back into the metaphysics objection already answered. Neither branch reaches the right — and notice the win takes no stand on whether gender is metaphysically real, only on whose life the concretes sit in.

Grant, even so, that the boundary is contestable at the margin. The form of the argument still proves far too much. Its schema is that a liberty grounded in self-declaration and certified by no external arbiter licenses indefinitely many absurd extensions and therefore grounds no right. Turn that schema on the liberties the objector keeps. Religious conversion is self-declared and certified by no arbiter — by this logic the right to convert has no principled stop. So with leaving a marriage, renouncing a citizenship, taking a new name, choosing a vocation against the one ascribed at birth: each a self-authored change of status with no external fact-maker beneath it.

A form that voids every liberty of self-authorship is not an argument about gender; it is an argument against self-authorship as such, wearing gender as a mask. As a defeater aimed at the gender right in particular it defeats itself, generalizing straight to the liberties the objector affirms: either those fall with it and the argument was never about gender, or the schema is dropped and the gender claim stands beside them. The point is internal to the objector's own commitments — no rival ranking of identities is asserted to make it land. The deliberately absurd rungs need no separate disposal; they name nothing anyone sustains as a mode of self-understanding, and the boundary that sorts the serious cases sorts them too. What is left to one side is a different claim often smuggled in alongside the slope — that self-ID corrodes the shared categories a society coordinates on, its sex-terms and its records. That is a third-party-harm claim, not a slope; it is foreclosed here as the wrong instrument and routed to where institutional and bystander costs are actually adjudicated, on the harm principle's preconditions rather than on any denial of self-ID.

What remains is a limiting line genuinely available to liberalism: the boundary between what is yours to live and what reaches into another's life, applied to gender exactly as to everything else. The case asserts no truth about who anyone really is, and does not say transition is good or to be encouraged. It says only that self-regarding liberty sits on the near side of that line, where every other self-regarding liberty already sits — which is the most the suite will ever say, and, against an objection that the right has no limit, exactly enough.

register_compliance.firewall_clean: Defeats the slope on STRUCTURE, not suffering. Route A (load-bearing) exhibits the self-regarding/other-regarding boundary — the harm principle's jurisdiction, already the wing's apparatus — as a non-arbitrary limiting line, refuting the universal-negative 'no line exists' by counterexample. Route B (secondary) is internal/tu-quoque: the slope-FORM voids every liberty of self-authorship (conversion, divorce, renaming, renunciation), singling out nothing. No suffering/dysphoria claim, defensive or affirmative. Williams-clean: Route A is a scope/jurisdiction point, Route B is the objector's own consistency — NO rival metaphysics of gender asserted, the line ranks neither gender nor species. Meme-rung disposal (attack-helicopter as category error) is a NAMED-DEPENDENCE amplifier, NOT load-bearing — the boundary sorts the serious rungs without it (the asymmetry-independence analogue). No Benatar asymmetry.

objections.tier_justification: Conceptual-Residue Arguendo. Concede every empirical/institutional fact (self-ID is in use; categories coordinate social goods; some will make absurd claims). Residue = 'no non-arbitrary limiting line exists' — a universal-negative. LOAD-BEARING (Route A): the hidden premise is that the only non-arbitrary stop is which-identity-is-metaphysically-real; that is false. The limiting line is the self-regarding/other-regarding boundary (harm-principle jurisdiction) — the most general, independently motivated liberal line, already sorting speech/religion/vocation/bodily-autonomy. Exhibiting ONE such principle DEFEATS the universal-negative; it does not merely dissolve it. Rung-sort: self-regarding rungs (privately-lived transrace/transage claiming nothing) are BITTEN — protected and unalarming; other-regarding rungs (enrolment-as-minor, reserved-remedy, law-exemption) are BLOCKED on harm-preconditions, NOT on self-ID-denial; the gender claim is blocked at the IDENTICAL joint when other-regarding — symmetry kills the special-pleading charge, and the line ranks neither identity (Williams-clean). No slope-specific conceptual machinery is invented — an existing wing principle is exhibited and a standard consistency test applied => T3 (structural/pragmatic), DEFEAT. Concedes NO surviving primitive (unlike S1's standing sex-fact), so per charter L179 the clean T3 defeat is A-eligible; the all-B signature governs T4-primitive-conceders only. SECONDARY (Route B, proves-too-much/parity): even granting the boundary contestable at the margin, the slope-FORM applied consistently voids divorce/conversion/renaming/renunciation — a defeater that proves that much singles out nothing; internal/tu-quoque, harm-principle-free, and so catches even an illiberal slope-objector. AMPLIFIER (named-dependence, NOT load-bearing): meme-rung disposal — attack-helicopter et al. are category errors, not identities-lived-as; the core sorts the serious rungs without disposing the memes (the asymmetry-independence analogue). RETREAT-HORN routes to S1 (foundation): 'without a truth-maker even the jurisdictional line floats' is the metaphysics-demand in jurisdictional dress — what makes the concretes self-regarding is whose life they sit in, grounded by non-domination, NOT gender's essence; forces drop-the-demand OR collapse-to-S1, both wins, the second is S1's. SCOPED-DEFEAT honest residual: defeats 'no line exists'; margin-contestability (is a pronoun-requirement self- or other-regarding) is ROUTED to B1/S4, not pretended-resolved. GATED OUT: 'socially-corrosive category-erosion as public harm' + institutional-ratification demands are third-party claims — S3 forecloses the SLOPE as the wrong instrument and routes them to the bystander three-prong (B1, charter L147-163) / compelled-participation (S4), adjudicated on harm not self-ID-denial. G1 PASS: vs spine — the spine ASSERTS the self-regarding boundary; S3 DEFENDS its non-arbitrariness against the special-pleading charge, sorts the reductio-ladder rung-by-rung, and runs the proves-too-much parity (three things the spine never does — subsumption-watch discharged, does NOT reduce to 'the right was always self-regarding-bounded, QED'). vs S1 — DISTINCTNESS-EDGE: the retreat-horn routes to S1; S1 relocates the right's OBJECT (to concrete self-presentation), S3 relocates the LIMITING PRINCIPLE (to harm-jurisdiction); Williams-guard holds, the line is metaphysics-blind. vs S2 — orthogonal: gift/preservation _|_ slope/limiting-principle; adjacency noted (S2 Route A charges the objector's first-order DUTY with selective application; S3 Route B charges the meta-level INFERENCE-SCHEMA with over-generation) — distinct targets, distinct levels.
